description: Practical facts for visiting one city: best months and crowd seasons, climate, annual events that change a visit, how to get from the airport, main station or cruise port to the centre (typical minutes), city passes, which sights are free, which need booking ahead, weekly closing days and dress codes. Every fact has a source and a check date. No prices or opening hours. Researched for some cities only; the answer says when a city is not covered yet.

city_id.description: Gingerguide city id, e.g. "rome" or "istanbul" (from search_cities).

language.description: Language of names and descriptions: en, es, fr, de, tr or zh.
